## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The parser removes `--wait` instead of keeping it as a deprecated alias, which goes against the ADR this pull request adds. Existing invocations now fail with exit code 2, so this needs fixing before merge.

## Changes
This pull request renames the CLI option `--wait` to `--timeout` in `app/cli.py` and updates the tests to match. It also adds ADR 007, which describes the transition, and a root-level `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Keep `--wait` as a deprecated alias for `--timeout` — `parse_args(["--wait", "12"])` now exits with status 2 because `--wait` is no longer registered. `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` says to "Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used." — Scripts that pass `--wait` stop working immediately, without the one-release deprecation period the ADR promises. — Fix: Register `--wait` with `dest="timeout"` and a deprecation warning, then extend `test_explicit_options` and `test_invalid_options` in `tests/test_cli.py` to cover the alias.
